senses.gloss:
संब् I. €1 P. (संबति) To go, move. ━II. €10 U. (संबयतिते)
 To collect, accumulate.

—1 The second ploughing of a field; (संबाकृ to plough twice); see
 शंब also.
—2 Water.

संबन्ध् €9 P.
—1 To bind or tie together, unite, join, connect, attach.
—2 To make, construct, form. ━Pass.
—1 To be connected with, go with, belong to.
—2 To be furnished or supplied with.

संबद्ध p. p.
—1 Bound or fastened together.
—2 Attached to.
—3 Connected with, related to, belonging to.
—4 Endowed with.
—5 Connected in sense.
—6 Closed, shut.

संबद्ध + .{@-द्धम्@} ind.
—1 Jointly; जगुश्चाप्सरसो राज्ञः यशः संबद्धमेव च Mb. 9. 61. 56.
—2 Moreover.
.━{@Comp.@}: संबद्धदर्प
संबद्ध + -दर्प a. one who has feelings of pride.

संबन्ध a. Able, capable.
—2 Fit, proper, right.

संबन्ध + .{@-न्धः@}
—1 Connection, union, association.
—2 Relation, relationship.
—3 Relation, as the meaning of the genitive case.
—4 Matrimonial alliance; विक्रियायै न कल्पन्ते संबन्धाः सदनुष्ठिताः
 Ku. 6. 29, 30; जनकानां रधूणां च संबन्धः कस्य न प्रियः U. 1. 17.
—5 Friendly connection, friendship; संबन्धमाभाषणपूर्वमाहुः R. 2. 58.
—6 Fitness, propriety.
—7 Prosperity, success.
—8 A relation, kinsman.
—9 A collection, volume, book.

संबन्धक a.
—1 Relating, concerning.
—2 Fit, suitable.

संबन्धक + .{@-कः@}
—1 A friend.
—2 A relation by birth or marriage; संबन्धकेन राजेन्द्र तौ तु वीर्यबलान्वयात्
 Mb. 5. 170. 10.

संबन्धक + .{@-कम्@}
—1 Relation, connection; सख्यं संबन्धकं चैव तदा तं प्रत्यपूजयत्
 Rām. 1. 11. 18.
—2 A kind of peace.

संबन्धिन् a.
—1 Relating or belonging to.
—2 Connected with, serving as an adjunct, inherent.
—3 Possessing good qualities. ━m.
—1 A relation by marriage; एष वः श्लाघ्यसंबन्धी जनकानां कुलोद्वहः U. 4. 9.
—2 A relation, kinsman (in general); संबन्धिनो वसिष्टादीनेष तातस्तवार्चति
 U. 1. 16; R. 2. 38.

संबन्धिन् + .{@-शब्दः@} an expression which gains its currency owing to the relationship
 existing between two persons or things; पत्नीति संबन्धिशब्दोऽयम्
 ŚB. on MS. 6. 1. 7.

—1 A dam, bridge.
—2 A kind of deer.
—3 N. of a demon slain by Pradyumna; see शंबर and प्रद्युम्न.
—4 N. of a mountain.

संबरः + .{@-रम्@}
—1 Restraint.
—2 Water.
—3 A kind of religious observance (with the Buddhists).
.━{@Comp.@}: संबरारिः, संबररिपुः
संबरः + -अरिः, -रिपुः Cupid.
संबरः + -अरिः, -रिपुः Cupid.

संबलः, -लम्
 Provision for a journey, viaticum.

संबलः, -लम्
 Provision for a journey, viaticum.
संबलः, -लम् + .{@-लम्@} Water.

संबाध् €1 Ā.
—1 To press heavily, to oppress, afflict, torment; injure, hurt.
—2 To compress, contract.
—3 To block up, throng, crowd.
—4 To bind firmly together.

संबाध a. Thronged or crowded with, blocked up, narrow; निगाढे
 युधि संबाधे वेत्स्यसे मां जनार्दन Mb. 5. 76. 14; संबाधं बृहदपि
 तद्बभूव वर्त्म Śi. 8. 2; व्योम्नि संबाधवर्त्मभिः R. 12. 67; अनेकसिद्धसाध्यसंबाधम् K.

संबाध + .{@-धः@}
—1 Being thronged with.
—2 Pressing on, striking, hurting; स्तनसंबाधमुरो जघान च Ku. 4. 26.
—3 Obstruction, difficulty, danger, impediment; मा गाश्चिरायैकचरः
 प्रमादं वसन्नसंबाधशिवेऽपि देशे Ki. 3. 53.
—4 The road to hell.
—5 Fear, dread.
—6 The vulva.

संबाधक a.
—1 Pressing together, contracting.
—2 Thronging, crowding.

—1 Blocking up, obstructing.
—2 Compressing.
—3 A barrier, gate.
—4 The vulva.
—5 The point of a stake.
—6 A door-keeper (m. ?).
संबाधनम् + .{@-ना@} Rubbing, chafing.

संबुध् €1 U., €4 Ā.
—1 To know, understand, learn; become aware of; संभुत्सीष्टाः सुनयनयनैर्विद्विषामीहितानि Bk. 19. 30.
—2 To perceive, observe, notice.
—3 To wake up, rise from sleep. ━Caus.
—1 To inform, acquaint with, give information about; तवागतिज्ञं समबोधयन्
 माम् R. 13. 25.
—2 To address, call out to.
—3 To instruct.
—4 To admonish, advise.
—5 To wake up, rouse.
—6 To explain.

संबुद्ध p. p.
—1 Well-understood.
—2 Very wise or prudent.
—3 Wide awake.
संबुद्ध + .{@-द्धः@} A Buddha or Jaina deified saint.

संबुद्धिः f.
—1 Perfect knowledge or perception; ततः पश्यन्त्यसंबुध्या वातपित्तकफोत्तरान्
 Mb. 12. 216. 11.
—2 Full consciousness.
—3 Calling to, addressing.
—4 (In gram.) The vocative case; एङ् ह्रस्वात् संबुद्धेः P. VI. 1. 69.
—5 An epithet.

—1 Explaining, instructing, informing.
—2 Full or correct perception.
—3 Sending, throwing.
—4 Loss, destruction.

—1 Explaining.
—2 Addressing.
—3 The vocative case.
—4 An epithet (used in calling a person); भूमौ स्थिता रमण नाथ मनोहरेति
 संबोधनैर्यमधिरोपितवत्यसि द्याम् Bv. 3. 13.
संबृंहणम् Strengthening, refreshing.

सांबन्धिक a. (-की f.)
 Arising from relationship.
सांबन्धिक + .{@-कम्@} Relationship, alliance.
